repository_evidence: The encounter only starts for players standing on the elevator transport (spell_nefarians_end_onyxia_start_fight_2_effect filters on GetTransGUID).
Onyxia cannot die before Nefarian has landed; Nefarian cannot die before phase 3.
Electrocute is scheduled 5 s after each 10% of Nefarian's health and adds 17 Onyxia charge.
Onyxia Electrical Charge ticks every 3 s (SpellMgr correction; client 1 s); Nefarian's copy adds 1 per 2 s while he is aggressive; overload at 100 stacks.
Shadowflame Breath deals one 1.5 s tick (SpellMgr correction; client 3 ticks at 0.5 s) in a 90-degree default cone.
Hail of Bones summons one bone warrior per tick: 4 in 10N, 10 in 25N, 5 in 10H, 12 in 25H (client periods 6/2.4/4.8/2 s over 24 s).
Animate Bones costs 3 energy per 1 s tick with no regeneration: a warrior collapses about 33 s after (re)animation; Breath and Shadowblaze refill it.
Empower (every 4 s): +100% damage and +10% speed per stack in normal, +200%/+15% heroic; a stunned warrior cannot gain a stack.
Bone warriors (38.7M health, mechanic_immune_mask 8462871) are not immune to stun, root, snare or Shackle Undead.
Brushfire Start (Shadowblaze Spark) targets one Animated Bone Warrior (conditions); Shadowblaze 81007 reanimates warriors within 4 yd.
Three prototypes (1.63M health in 10N) cast Blast Nova (4 s cast, 30 s room-wide aura); normal phase 3 needs all three dead, heroic only one.
Phase 2 falls back to phase 3 after 150 s (DBM Shadowflame Barrage active window 150 s agrees).
The Shadowblaze Spark interval floor was 10 s in every mode; repaired this round to 15 s normal / 10 s heroic (BigWigs and DBM).
Wipe: FAIL despawns spawn group 402 and resummons Nefarian after 30 s; the intro flag is not written to the instance save.

strategy.duty_plan: BotNefarianDutyPlan.h: Nefarian tank = best living tank by capability (Blood DK, Protection Paladin, Protection Warrior, Feral); Onyxia tank = next tank, also the bone-warrior handler; pillar teams (round 8): one healer each; with two healers both roster tanks (dead or alive, so teams never reshuffle) and only they take the healerless pillar (TankPillar, the user's tactic followed literally); then a <=13 s interrupter where a team has none (Kick, Rebuke; the tank pillar has Mind Freeze), then the remaining damage dealers balance the healer pillars' prototype damage (none joins the tank pillar: the model loses them there); the tank pillar's interrupters are its tanks (Mind Freeze, then Skull Bash), the other pillars' the shortest cooldown; shackler = first living non-tank with Shackle Undead.

pillar_2: blood_death_knight (no healer; Mind Freeze 10 s, Death Strike)
feral_druid_tank (backup Skull Bash, 60 s without Brutal Impact; Frenzied Regeneration, Survival Instincts, Enrage when unglyphed)

strategy.phase_1_damage: Normal: everyone burns Onyxia from the pull; the canonical boss-lust fallback (BotRaidBossLust.h) casts the mage's Time Warp about 5 s after the Feral holds Onyxia (Onyxia is a boss mob, type_flags 0x4, so Creature::isWorldBoss admits her). Heroic fallback: Onyxia until 12%, then Nefarian down to 73% while Onyxia's charge is below 60 (two Electrocutes, +34 charge natively), then finish Onyxia.
strategy.movement_interface: SurfaceGoal (BotNefarianMovement.h) reached in legs of at most 9.5 yd (BotNefarianPath.h: the whole floor inside r 57 is walkable; every leg ends at the model floor height of its end, FloorLocalZAt, with a 0.6 yd tolerance; a leg over a ramp crease is capped at 6 yd; legs keep 7 yd from every pillar centre, through one or two waypoints on r 27 or r 50 when the straight segment does not; every simulated and planner-coverage leg is verified against the sampled model by tests/test_nefarian_movement.py), each submitted as BotNativeAction::TransportSurfaceMove Walk with EndOnTransport (BotNefarianSurfaceIntent.h); never an ordinary Move on the platform. Phase 2 steps: Float, Swim, Hop, Board (BotNefarianAscent.h); phase 3 descent: Walk, StepOff, Fall, Land. Typed holds: nefarian_elevator_unobserved, nefarian_not_on_platform, nefarian_movement_stunned, nefarian_no_surface_path, nefarian_leg_in_flight, nefarian_magma_rising, nefarian_wading_until_float_depth, nefarian_float_hold_for_pillar, nefarian_descent_wait_for_raised_floor.
strategy.phase_1_tanking: Pull: the tank stands on the ring at r 52 on a radially clear heading at the dragon's end; the chasing dragon stops at its reach, about r 29-31. Hold: once the dragon is at r >= 27.5 within 15 degrees of its end, the tank stands 7 yd from it, tangential and 25 degrees outward, so it only turns. Opposite ends are then >= 53 yd apart; the chase-model test settles them 62 yd apart.
strategy.bone_warrior_control: The Feral handler (free once Onyxia is dead) taunts loose warriors, casts Nature's Grasp 16689 (3 charges, roots 27 s on melee hit) when one attacks it, and kites them around a pen 24 yd out on Nefarian's far flank. Any bot leading warriors (the handler once Nefarian is down, or a bot an unheld warrior attacks) takes only destinations and legs whose whole straight path stays at least 15 degrees outside his breath cone and off his tail: fire and breath escapes, kites and the pen alike. Rooted (19975, 339), stunned or shackled warriors are held and never damaged. Shackle Undead backs up on the most empowered warrior not on the handler. Interrupts, taunts and controls are named only for a bot that knows the spell (NativeFacts::SpellKnown/SpellReady).

user_tactics.source: user raid experience 2026-09-26 (authoritative: user tactics outrank guides and inference)
user_tactics.composition: 2 tanks (Blood DK, Feral), 2 healers (Holy Paladin, Discipline Priest), 6 DPS; the shaman stays Elemental.
user_tactics.phase_1: Bloodlust and burn Onyxia from the pull, before Nefarian lands; no Electrocute pacing. The user expects this may not hold on heroic or with lower gear: heroic keeps the Electrocute budget (PhaseOnePacingFor).
user_tactics.phase_2: Swim in the magma as it rises beside your pillar; once the pillar top is level with the surface, hop onto it and damage the prototype there.
user_tactics.bone_warriors: The Feral druid kites them, rooting them with Nature's Grasp as much as possible; with enough Onyxia-phase damage there are few. They must never get in front of Nefarian: his breath wakes them, refills their energy and buffs them (confirmed by the user).
user_tactics.conflicts: Replaces the guide-derived Electrocute pacing (Wowhead, Icy Veins) in 10N, the three-healer composition, the stun/root/snare controller rotation, and the round-2 pillar_ascent_unsupported blocker.
user_tactics.phase_2_pillars: Round 8 (user raid experience 2026-09-26, authoritative): the tanks take the healerless pillar and heal themselves - the Blood DK with Death Strike, the Feral with its self-heals (Frenzied Regeneration, Enrage for rage); 'Feral healing himself might be enough'. When another pillar kills its prototype, one healer and one DPS from it (not all at once) swim across the lava to the tank pillar and help finish.

strategy.phase_2_ascent: BotNefarianAscent.h and BotNefarianMagma.h, data nefarian_magma_v1.json: walk to the pillar foot (9.5 yd, slot heading) while the floor keeps still; the magma (world 2.7713) covers the ring 5.5 s after the platform starts down; at 1.2 yd depth Float (stop standing on the platform like a client that starts swimming), Swim to the station 6.7 yd from the pillar centre at the float depth, hold; at the lowered stop the top is 0.286 above the surface: Hop (the client jump, 7.95577 yd/s up, at most run speed, checked as the exact MoveSpline MoveJumpWithGravity runs: duration from the 3D segment, the ballistic air time rounded down) onto the rim just above the waterline, Board, walk up to the slot on the flat top (3.0 yd). About 8 s in the magma: 8 ticks = 47,000 fire before resistance (5000 + 250 k per tick). Float, Swim and Hop are package T stages requested in patch N1; without them the plan carries the typed blocker pillar_ascent_unsupported (W1 watchdog terminal). A late swimmer when the floor rises meets it and rides up 0.25 yd/s slower than it, boarding within a band about 2 s long.
strategy.phase_3_descent: Once the floor is back at the raised stop and before Nefarian lands (Shadow of Cowardice 79355 punishes passengers above local 9.5 every 2 s): walk to the rim (5.0 yd), StepOff past the wall, Fall 7-8 yd onto the skirt or ring (below the 14.57 yd fall-damage threshold), Land; package T's existing stages.
strategy.healerless_pillar: Coordinator default pending the user's answer and the live run: the Elemental shaman off-heals pillar 2 with Healing Surge 8004 (in its action profile) on the lowest teammate it can reach (40 yd, line of sight) under 90%, after its Blast Nova interrupt; before the floor goes under the Disc priest shields everyone and the Holy paladin tops up anyone under 95%, pillar 2 first. Resource-limited model (tests/test_nefarian_phase_two_survival.py, nefarian_phase_two_survival_v1.json: finite mana, 1.5 s casts landing at completion and never across a swim or hop, the Barrage every 3.2 s (WCL 10N cadence, native repaired from 2.5 s) landing after its 2 s cast and a 1.73 s missile flight from Nefarian's phase 2 lift-off position, realised preparation, phase 2 lasting until the last prototype dies; interrupts not modelled): a pillar-2 death before phase 2 ends in 9% of trials (mean phase 49 s), 2% with 1.25x and 0% (0.5%) with 1.5x raid DPS (44% before the Barrage cadence repair). Alternatives: a pure burn pillar 2 (option A) 100%, a tank pillar 68%; option B (a healer reaching two pillars) is geometrically impossible (nearest pillar tops 62.5 yd apart, heals reach 40). This is not a native estimate: single-assumption changes move the default from about 0% to 42%. The live run decides pillar-2 viability.

phase_2_tank_pillar.self_care: BotNefarianTankSelfCare.h under Barrage (pillar phases), after the pillar interrupt: Blood DK Death Strike 49998 on its prototype under 80%; Feral Survival Instincts 61336 under 30%; Frenzied Regeneration 22842 under 50% with the Glyph of Frenzied Regeneration (canonical: no rage conversion, so no Enrage), under 60% after Enrage 5229 without it (rage conversion; NativeFacts::UnglyphedFrenziedRegeneration from the bot's aura 54810). Spells the bot does not know are never named; M provisions Enrage, Frenzied Regeneration and Divine Shield for both paladins.
phase_2_tank_pillar.cross_pillar_help: BotNefarianCrossing.h: the first healer pillar to kill its prototype (the observer's kill order persists it; a dead healer releases it) sends its healer and one damage dealer - one with a magma defensive it actually has ready if any, else the first by slot (the healer heals the pair) - while the platform rests lowered and the tank pillar's prototype keeps >=25%, each at >=80% health. At the rim a ready defensive (Divine Shield 642, Pain Suppression 33206) is cast first, with no movement proposed that decision so it owns the cast lanes; the step waits until it is up with >=6 s left (Forbearance, cooldown and the window are rechecked there). The step into the lava uses the ledge-drop contract's liquid variant (TransportSurfaceMove::LandInLiquid, patch R8_ledge_drop_into_liquid.patch; the dry-ground contract still refuses liquid), then fall, land on the sunken ring, float, swim, hop onto a spare slot of the tank pillar. Until the executor carries LandInLiquid nobody crosses.
phase_2_tank_pillar.survival_model: nefarian_phase_two_survival_v1.json user_tank_pillar_* (the literal layout: the tanks alone on the tank pillar; not a native estimate, recorded without deviating on it): a tank-pillar death before phase 2 ends in 0% of trials (mean phase 76 s), a helper death 0%, and a death on the pillar the healer left 18%; without the help 3% (106 s); with the Elemental off-healer on the tank pillar 3%, with it and the warlock 22% (regenerated with the 3.2 s WCL Barrage cadence; the 2.5 s values were 50%, 27%, 16% and 75%).
phase_2_tank_pillar.frenzied_regeneration_glyph: The canonical Feral carries Glyph of Frenzied Regeneration (item 40896, spell 54810): Frenzied Regeneration then converts no rage into health but raises healing received by 30%; the self-care handles both (glyph observed on the bot). M owns glyphs.

acceptance_observations: Every bot is a passenger of GO 207834 before Onyxia's start-fight pulse (no bot pulls from the ledge).
The lust (Time Warp 80353) lands within about 5 s of the Feral holding Onyxia; every DPS damages Onyxia until she dies.
Dragon separation stays above 50 yd after Nefarian lands (no Children of Deathwing 78619/78620 uptime on either dragon beyond the lead-out).
No non-tank is hit by Shadowflame Breath; Lightning Discharge 77943 lands only during the tank's discharge turn window, if at all.
Onyxia's charge stays below 100 at her death.
Phase 2: every bot floats, swims to its station and hops onto its pillar at the lowered stop; Magma 81114 ticks per bot about 8 (47k), none after the hop.
Every Blast Nova 80734 cast is interrupted (SPELL_INTERRUPT events; no 80735 ticks).
No bot damages Nefarian during phase 2 (no Electrocute during phase 2).
Every bot leaves its pillar before Nefarian lands (no Shadow of Cowardice 79353) and takes no fall damage.
No active bone warrior stands in Nefarian's front cone; no warrior is hit by Shadowflame Breath; the Feral casts Nature's Grasp when warriors reach it.

Round 3 (user tactic: the Feral kites the bone warriors with Nature's Grasp and keeps them out of Nefarian's front): no Animated Bone Warrior 41918 stays active (selectable, without feign death 70628) for more than 45 s, and none stands on a pillar structure (within 7 yd of a pillar centre above local z 3.75). Recorded live as decision-trace actions nefarian_bone_warrior_active_over_45s / nefarian_bone_warrior_on_pillar (BotNefarianWarriorWatch.h); any entry fails the observation.
No bot takes Shadowblaze 81007 damage for more than one tick.
Native clear: boss state done, encounter credit, 0 boss-window deaths.

round6_batch1_first_attempt.evidence: artifacts/cata_raid_program/round6_batch1_20260926.tar.gz shard blackwing_descent_10n_nefarian_c0; combat log reassembled from the console export
round6_batch1_first_attempt.outcome: reached bwd.nefarian.encounter; about 28 phase-1 attempts, each ending in a dragon evade and respawn (wipe_generation 0); emergency_wall_clock_timeout after 79 minutes
root_causes: native combat range (and route) movement pathed bots off the raised transport over the static navmesh into the magma bowl (8,612 of 11,104 combat range requests below z 5); the dragons followed their victims down
casters lost line of sight to Onyxia past the pillars, which triggered that range recovery

slow Onyxia pickup (her first melee on the Feral 34.4 s after her first damage): the warlock landed first and opened on her 1.2 s before any tank; the Feral dropped last, landed behind pillar 0 (7.9 yd from its centre) and its Growl failed on line of sight for 24 s; the lust fallback therefore waited until 38.9 s
fixes: PlatformHold with a renewed Mechanic lease on the platform, also as the fallback beside every proposed leg; admitted legs publish their lease (Hazard for survival escapes)
pillar-sight and range-checked formation spots for ranged and healers (36 yd), the arrival tolerance only while sight and range hold from where the bot stands
damage dealers hold fire (the Target lane) before the pull and until a tank has Onyxia; her tank walks to a pillar-clear pickup spot within Growl range
non-tanks keep 4 yd from a dragon's centre (Spell.cpp skips the cone check inside the target's bounding radius, at least 2 yd)
heal guard (shared patch R7_protected_movement_heal_guard.patch): a protected Nefarian leg or escape allows only instant heals and is never stopped by a hard cast
route engagement observer for Nefarian (41376 only, never Onyxia), wiring patch R7_nefarian_route_observation.patch

Onyxia pickup ownership until she targets her tank, bounded across decisions (10 s, 4 rejected spots or ~3 s stalled without sight; then nefarian_pickup_exhausted and the damage dealers start); the Blood DK keeps Onyxia while she lives when the Feral is dead, then tanks Nefarian
open: Resolved in round 8 (r07 evidence): Onyxia's template carries CREATURE_STATIC_FLAG_UNKILLABLE; the script now clears it when Nefarian lands.
watchdog counts party damage as progress while the encounter keeps resetting (tools/bot_ml/run_live_bot_validation.py)
the route drops the Onyxia tank last (it was still on the ledge approach when the node advanced); a Feral-first drop would shorten the pickup further

round7_batch1.evidence: artifacts/cata_raid_program/round7_batch1_20260926.tar.gz shard blackwing_descent_10n_nefarian_c0; combat log export complete (15,265 events, none dropped)
round7_batch1.outcome: reached bwd.nefarian.encounter; three phase-1 attempts of 139-141 s each, ended by encounter_reset_loop_watchdog; wipe_generation 0, 1 death recorded
round7_batch1.root_cause: Onyxia's 4.3.4 creature_template StaticFlags (0x5089000c, sql/updates/world/4.3.4/2023_08_27_00_world.sql) carry CREATURE_STATIC_FLAG_UNKILLABLE, which Unit::DealDamage enforces after her AI's DamageTaken; the landing chain completed every attempt (landed_received allow_death=1) yet she took exactly max-1 health (5,582,979) and every later hit landed 0 (reached 1 health at 61, 80 and 62 s). Her Electrical Charge then reached 100 about 140 s after each pull and Electrical Overload (78999, 855k-1.045M Nature to all) wiped the raid; the dragons reset. The same flag explains the r06 1-health stalls.
other_findings: the platform hold held: one magma event in the whole run, bots on the platform at every reset
